content.value_statement: CloudFormation templates can become fragile, hard to review, and risky to update. This skill guides template structure, validation, drift checks, and production deployment patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guides YAML-based CloudFormation template structure and parameter design.
Recommends Conditions, Mappings, Outputs, Exports, and DeletionPolicy patterns.
Provides a parameterized VPC template example with environment and CIDR parameters.
Suggests validation with AWS CloudFormation, cfn-lint, and cfn-nag.
Helps troubleshoot UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED with rollback recovery guidance.
limitations: Focuses on raw CloudFormation, not CDK or Terraform.
Does not deploy stacks or call AWS services by itself.
Does not replace AWS account-specific security review.
Examples must be adapted to organization standards and account constraints.

use_cases.title: Template Review
use_cases.description: Assess a CloudFormation template for readability, parameters, conditions, outputs, and stateful resource protection.

use_cases.title: Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Prepare stack templates for repeatable deployments across development, staging, and production environments.

use_cases.title: Stack Troubleshooting
use_cases.description: Analyze update failures, rollback states, and drift symptoms before planning corrective actions.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing CloudFormation file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CloudFormation YAML for readability, parameters, conditions, outputs, and stateful resource protection. Summarize risks before suggesting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Reuse
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest changes that make this CloudFormation template reusable across dev, staging, and prod. Focus on parameters, mappings, conditions, and naming.

prompt_templates.title: Design Nested Stacks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture planning for larger infrastructure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a nested CloudFormation stack structure for this infrastructure. Separate ownership boundaries, exports, dependencies, and deployment order.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Rollback Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this CloudFormation rollback failure. Identify likely root causes, resources to inspect, recovery commands to consider, and follow-up template fixes.

output_examples.input: A VPC template uses hardcoded environment names and lacks outputs.
output: Move environment names into parameters with allowed values.
Add outputs for stable cross-stack references.

output_examples.input: A production database template has no retention policies.
output: Add retention protection for stateful resources.
Review update replacement behavior before deployment.
Document recovery expectations for production data.

output_examples.input: A stack update failed and entered rollback recovery.
output: Identify the failing resource before retrying deployment.
Use rollback recovery only after understanding the root cause.
Fix the template so the skipped resource can be reconciled.

best_practices: Parameterize environment-specific values and keep static lookups in mappings.
Use outputs and exports for stable cross-stack references.
Protect stateful resources with retention and replacement policies.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding account IDs, ARNs, or environment names in templates.
Combining unrelated resources into one monolithic stack.
Deploying templates without linting, validation, or change review.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy CloudFormation stacks?
faq.answer: No. It gives review and design guidance. Deployment requires your AWS tooling and approval.

faq.question: Can it review existing templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze structure, parameters, outputs, conditions, and production readiness.

faq.question: Does it support Terraform or CDK?
faq.answer: No. The skill is focused on raw AWS CloudFormation templates.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include security review?
faq.answer: It can suggest CloudFormation review points, but account-specific security checks remain your responsibility.

faq.question: What template format works best?
faq.answer: YAML works best because the skill guidance emphasizes readability and CloudFormation intrinsic functions.
